children: Franklin Covey appointed M. Sean Covey as Chief Product Officer and hired John Buchanan as Executive Vice President, Education; Colleen Dom to retire as Executive Vice President, Operations with Adam Sherman succeeding her.
Chief Product Officer (transitioning from President, Education Division)
Senior Vice President, Revenue and Customer Operations (will succeed Ms. Dom)
Retirement after over 40 years of service
Will be succeeded by Adam Sherman effective June 1, 2027
President, Education Division since Sept 2017; former EVP of Innovations; NYT best-selling author; BYU undergrad; MBA Harvard Business School; compensation unchanged
Previously Chief Growth Officer at GoGuardian; former CMO at Care.com; leadership roles at LegalZoom, NFL, Adobe, EA; USC undergrad
EVP, Operations since Sept 2013; instrumental in client services, sales support, operations, management, supply chain
Joined Sept 2024 as VP, Revenue Operations for Enterprise North America; expanded responsibilities; prior leadership roles at Zoom and LinkedIn; San Jose State undergrad
